label: Forehead width

range.endpoint_anchor: frontal width / L: 0.24 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.12 -> -100 = 0.12, +100 = 0.36 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.24) / 0.12)

region.mask_rule: frontal bone band between the orbits; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Frontal breadth between the orbits as a fraction of L (cat +50, wolf +5 [S-derived]). Bounds the brow band: a continuous brow bar (BrowContinuity +100) spans this width but cannot exceed it (brow-study section 5.8). A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
